title: hyperqualia
blurb: a real hyperplane slice through a rotating tesseract — now tumbling through all six of its 4D rotation planes (drag it to steer), with the slice's 8 cubic cells filled in as the true glowing solid facets they are, not just wireframe. standing in for @fubarchitect.com's line that mind-facing output is higher dimensional and narrative is just the accessible slice of it: a scatter of hyperqualia inducers (breathwork, ayahuasca, dance, dmt, prayer...) only enter the slice, and the scrolling narrative line, when the plane actually reaches them.
